law_name: Chair, French-Ukrainian parliamentary friendship group (parliamentary diplomacy)
description: As deputy (2022-2024), Haddad chaired the National Assembly's French-Ukrainian friendship group and served on the Foreign Affairs and European Affairs committees, focusing on support for Ukraine following the Russian invasion.
significance: Positioned him as a leading parliamentary voice on Ukraine and transatlantic security, a profile that underpinned his appointment as Minister for Europe.

law_name: Joint transatlantic lawmakers' letter urging US Congress to unlock military aid to Ukraine
description: In December 2023 Haddad co-authored a joint letter signed by more than a hundred senior European lawmakers to their US counterparts, pressing the United States Congress to release further military aid to Ukraine.
significance: High-profile cross-parliamentary initiative reinforcing transatlantic support for Ukraine at a critical moment in the war.

description: Shortly after his September 2024 appointment as Minister Delegate for Europe, Haddad announced he would push the European Union to tighten its migration and immigration policy guidelines, framing it as a cross-partisan demand from citizens to 'take back control' of migration.
significance: Defined an early policy priority of his ministerial mandate and aligned France with a tougher EU migration stance.

law_name: EU trade-defence and economic sovereignty advocacy (ministerial)
description: As Minister for Europe, Haddad publicly argued that Europe should use 'all the tools' at its disposal to defend its interests against aggressive foreign trade practices, describing Europe as the 'last evangelist' of a rules-based trade order.
significance: Reflects his ministerial line on European economic sovereignty and trade defence amid global trade tensions.
